notes: WArmy 0.4.34 — protected-area policy correction + Dao hard gate. (1) Prompt layers are no longer protected areas: session norms/short-memory (guifan), impressions/soft-gates (impressions) and requirements (yaoqiu) are readable/writable by the model, so the summary feature can refine prompts unblocked; skills and plugin directories are likewise open. (2) Plugin/skill/runtime subtrees (dsh*, warmy-dsh, skills, plugins, scan-dirs) are exempt from program-install-dir protection even when they live inside the install directory — reading/managing plugins is normal work, not "viewing other sessions" or "modifying the program itself". (3) The Dao (dao.md) and other absolutely-unchangeable prompts are now HARD-gated: registered at startup, blocked across every tool path (work-tools, run_shell, open_path, download_file, desktop_file_op) and never releasable even via a one-time authorization card — only the user can save them in the UI. Closed bypasses: bare-filename redirect after cd (echo x > dao.md), desktop ops in full-authorization mode, and download fallback to raw path. Still protected: other sessions workspaces, long-term memory, account/auth files, and the program binary itself. Changed-area verification passed three consecutive clean rounds (truth tables + real-device probes). Carries all prior features unchanged.
